name: Farm
tagline: Sends the heavy coding work off to its own machine and brings back just the result
description: Built for developers who watch a week's allowance disappear by Tuesday. It stands up separate working seats on the computer it controls, then pushes the long grinding tasks out to them instead of running them in front of you. What returns to your conversation is the finished answer, so the thread stays light and cheap.
author: mpieras
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
